title: Capunet Vegetariani alle Lenticchie
subtitle: Recipe Formulation Sheet

source.title: Capunet vegetariani alle lenticchie
source.author: Anna Fracassi
source.note: Translated from the Italian. Ingredient quantities, yield, difficulty, and all three timings match the original exactly.

scalingPrinciple: Item A.01 (Potatoes) is locked at 100.0% as the dominant filling mass. All other components are expressed relative to that 200 g baseline, including the cabbage wrapper, so the filling-to-leaf ratio holds when the batch is scaled up.

rows.name: Potatoes
rows.role: Primary starch substrate; peeled and finely diced.

rows.name: Red Lentils
rows.role: Protein and structural body; cooked al dente with the potato.

rows.name: Stale Bread (preferably wholemeal)
rows.role: Crumbled binder; absorbs residual moisture from the lentil-potato mixture.

rows.name: Eggs
rows.role: Primary binder; sets the filling during the bake.

rows.name: Onion
rows.role: Finely chopped; sautéed with the potato.

rows.name: Cabbage Leaves
rows.role: Structural wrapper; blanched to pliability, thick central ribs thinned with a peeler.

rows.name: Vegetable Broth
rows.role: Added gradually during the lentil-potato cook.

rows.name: Extra Virgin Olive Oil
rows.role: Sauté fat plus finishing drizzle before and after baking.

total.role: Combined raw material input footprint, excluding broth, oil, and seasoning.

matrixFootnote: *Eggs, onion, garlic, and cabbage leaves are given in the source by count. Gram values shown are standard culinary unit-weight conversions and are marked accordingly; lentils, potatoes, bread, and cheese masses are stated directly.

mise.label: Leaf Selection & Blanching (D.01)
mise.text: Select the largest cabbage leaves and blanch them briefly in boiling water to soften. If the central rib is very tough, thin it out with a vegetable peeler.

mise.label: Vegetable Prep (A.01, C.01, C.02)
mise.text: Peel and finely dice the potatoes. Finely chop the onion and garlic.

execution.name: Build the Base
execution.text: Sauté the diced potatoes with the finely chopped onion and garlic in a pan with a drizzle of oil. Add the red lentils and begin cooking over medium heat, gradually adding the broth.

execution.name: Reduce & Bind with Bread
execution.text: After 15 minutes, when the lentils and potatoes are al dente, raise the heat and simmer the mixture, adding the crumbled stale bread (or bread ground in a blender). Season with salt and pepper, mix well while mashing lightly, then turn off the heat and let cool.

execution.name: Enrich the Filling
execution.text: In a large bowl, combine the cooled mixture with the beaten eggs and the grated cheese. Mix until the filling is smooth and uniform.

execution.name: Roll the Capunet
execution.text: Take the blanched cabbage leaves and place a portion of the filling in the center of each, then roll them up to form the rolls.

execution.name: Bake
execution.text: Arrange the rolls on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and drizzle them with oil. Bake in a preheated oven for about 30 minutes — 15 on the lower rack and 15 in the middle — until golden brown and slightly crispy on top.

execution.name: Serve
execution.text: Serve hot with a drizzle of extra virgin olive oil.

directive: Let the lentil-potato mixture cool fully before the eggs go in. Folding beaten egg into a hot filling scrambles it on contact and costs you the binder that holds the roll together through the bake.
